nodes.n: How a request reaches a service
nodes.text:
1. A *.hrmsmrflrii.xyz name resolves via Cloudflare (inside the house, via Technitium, Pi-hole as backup).
2. Traefik (CT203) terminates TLS with the Let's Encrypt wildcard cert.
3. Authentik ForwardAuth checks the Google SSO login.
4. Traefik forwards to the service on its VLAN 40 address.
Remote: Tailscale subnet routing through node01 (VLANs 20, 40, 90).

An agent proposes a change → Discord approval card plus a GitLab issue → you react ✅ → boss.service runs the exact command → Grafana gets a "Roundtable changes" marker → Blaidd verifies.
Patching: sre-agent, 02:00–05:00 Manila, backup gate first, auto-reboot, then checks.

PBS (CT100 on node03) keeps two datastores: "daily" on a 1 TB NVMe and "main" on a 4 TB HDD. Node configs go to the NAS (ProxmoxData) before patching. Iji watches backups every 30 min and reports at 08:00.

node01: 28 vCPU on 16 threads; RAM fully allocated (60 of 60 GiB).
node02: 10 vCPU on 16 threads; 14 of 28 GiB.
node03: running guests allotted 31.8 GiB on a 31 GiB host (overcommitted).

nodes.text: Inter-VLAN ACLs live on the ER605 and are owned by Torrent. All of them were switched off on 2026-10-16 after phase 4 blocked Omada management and some DNS, so traffic between VLANs is unfiltered. Check the live rule order before turning them back on.

Since 18 Oct 2026: DHCP hands out Technitium 192.168.90.60 (homelab-dns01, primary: recursive, DNSSEC, blocklists) then Pi-hole 192.168.90.53 (CT202, secondary). Proxmox nodes, LXCs and VMs use the same pair. Local names live in Technitium; Torrent copies them to Pi-hole daily (dns-sync). VLAN 1 still gets Pi-hole only.
Planned: replace Pi-hole with a second Technitium and cluster the two.
Links and port names come from Omada (18 Oct 2026). Links marked "docs" come from older notes and were not confirmed live. Client counts are a snapshot from the same day.

atlas.title: Services
atlas.blurb: What runs where: containers and services per host, with ports

nodes.text: Jellyseerr/Overseerr request → Sonarr (TV) or Radarr (movies) → Prowlarr searches the indexers (FlareSolverr for captchas) → Deluge downloads → library on the NAS (Proxmox-Media) → Jellyfin. Bazarr adds subtitles, Tdarr transcodes. Nepheli watches the stack every 10 min.
Watchtower checks images and asks for a Discord approval. The Service Version Manager (:5070) tracks versions; Glance's Update button now files a Roundtable approval instead of calling it directly.
Ports shown are on the host IP. People reach services through Traefik + Authentik at *.hrmsmrflrii.xyz; raw ports are for the LAN and the agents.

nodes.text: An agent files an approval with the exact command. It appears in Discord (and GitLab issue #6 project); you react ✅ or ❌. boss.service runs only approved commands, records the result in olympus.db, posts a Grafana marker, and Enia/Blaidd audit it.

Leads and engineers use gpt-6-luna or gpt-6.1-sol; companions and specialists use gpt-6-sol; watchers (Sellen, Iji, Enia, Boc, Diallos, Blaidd) are deterministic code with no model cost. Boc tracks spend against the $65/month budget.
